subject: history_social
passage: In 2019, volunteers in a coastal town in Maine finished restoring an old lighthouse and opened it as a small museum. Town historian Ruth Callahan has kept a record of how many people visit the museum each year. Her records show that the museum's lowest yearly attendance came in ______

data.title: Yearly Visitors to a Lighthouse Museum in Maine

stem: Which choice most effectively uses data from the graph to complete the statement?

choices.A: 2021, when about 1,400 people visited the museum.
choices.B: 2024, the year with the highest attendance shown.
choices.C: 2019, when about 3,200 people visited the museum.
choices.D: 2020, when about 1,900 people visited the museum.

explanation.why: The statement asks for the year of lowest attendance, so find the lowest point on the line. The line drops to about 1,900 visitors in 2020, its lowest value.
explanation.A: Incorrect. This misreads the graph: about 4,100 people visited in 2021, not about 1,400.
explanation.B: Incorrect. 2024 had the highest attendance, which is the opposite of what the statement describes.
explanation.C: Incorrect. About 3,200 people did visit in 2019, but that is more than the roughly 1,900 who visited in 2020.
explanation.D: Correct. About 1,900 people visited in 2020, fewer than in any other year shown.
